scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/studio/*.test.mjs dist/studio/ && cp src/proofPoints/*.test.mjs dist/proofPoints/ && cp src/notify/*.test.mjs dist/notify/ && cp src/data/*.test.mjs dist/data/ && cp src/*.test.mjs dist/ && cp src/data/*.gz dist/data/
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/studio/*.test.mjs dist/proofPoints/*.test.mjs dist/data/*.test.mjs dist/notify/*.test.mjs dist/*.test.mjs
